verdict.rationale: VLP documents a dedicated Privacy & Data Security Practice Group that advises clients on the CCPA and other state privacy laws, the EU GDPR, Canada's PIPEDA and other foreign data-protection laws. That directly matches the story's 'GDPR, CCPA, or local equivalents' requirement. The evidence is a single first-party summary line. Missing for 10: detail on specific privacy services (e.g., DPAs, privacy programs, breach/cyber incident response), any mention of India's DPDP Act, and independent corroboration of the practice.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: VLP's Privacy & Data Security Practice Group is dedicated to helping clients navigate a constantly shifting landscape of privacy and data security laws
the CCPA and other state privacy laws
European Union (GDPR), Canada (PIPEDA) and other foreign data protection laws
